assessment.summary: The observed behavior has multiple plausible explanations.

claims.text: The observed network activity differs from the established baseline.

security_relationships.explanation: The observed network pattern differs from the established baseline and therefore requires contextual investigation.

alternative_explanations.explanation: The activity may represent legitimate software updating.
The activity may represent an unauthorized process communicating with an external service.

unknowns: The available evidence is insufficient to determine which explanation is correct.
recommendations: Correlate the network activity with process execution history.
Review the destination and timing of the observed connections.

knowledge.title: Linux Network Behavior
knowledge.content: Unexpected network behavior should be evaluated together with process and system context.

limitations: The available evidence does not distinguish between the proposed explanations.
